name: usaco_benchmark
description: A dataset of competitive programming problems drawn from USACO designed to evaluate models' algorithmic problem-solving and program synthesis abilities. Models are assessed on producing correct programs that pass hidden test cases, measuring generalization across standard contest-style tasks. The benchmark targets correctness, efficiency, and robustness of generated solutions under contest constraints.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (correctness on held-out test cases, i.e., pass rate)
reputation: Uses well-known USACO contest problems and is valued for testing algorithmic coding ability, but is less ubiquitous than larger code benchmarks.
